WorkListing.creatorAccountId.effects: Immutable creator attribution only; no identity ownership transfer or User/Session/Participant mutation.
WorkListing.creatorAccountId.authority: Mandatory current scoped authorize callback; consuming host holds current actor/session/Guild authority to commit. Root app composition not enabled.
WorkListing.creatorAccountId.fold: Restrict FK preserves history and fails closed on account deletion; no automatic rehome or fold enablement.
WorkListing.creatorAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end migration/authority review pending.

RaidOffer.offeredByAccountId.effects: Immutable offer issuer attribution only; no User/Session/Participant mutation or identity transfer.
RaidOffer.offeredByAccountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical actor plus exact creator/Guild MANAGE_LISTING host authorization held through commit. Root not enabled.
RaidOffer.offeredByAccountId.fold: Restrict preserves offer history and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
RaidOffer.offeredByAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration review pending.

WorkReview.reviewerAccountId.effects: Immutable reviewer attribution only; no User/Session/Participant mutation or identity transfer.
WorkReview.reviewerAccountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical actor equal to the accepted terms' exact reviewer account and not an engagement member, rechecked after the engagement lock. Root not enabled.
WorkReview.reviewerAccountId.fold: Restrict preserves review history and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
WorkReview.reviewerAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration/capacity review pending.

EngagementClosure.closedByAccountId.effects: Immutable closer attribution only; no User/Session/Participant mutation or identity transfer.
EngagementClosure.closedByAccountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical actor: the accepted terms' independent reviewer on acceptance, or a host-authorized operations actor after the accepted operational deadline, rechecked after the engagement lock. Root not enabled.
EngagementClosure.closedByAccountId.fold: Restrict preserves closure history and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
EngagementClosure.closedByAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration/capacity review pending.

EngagementAmendment.proposedByAccountId.effects: Immutable proposer attribution only; no User/Session/Participant mutation or identity transfer. A proposal changes no effective term until the affected member consents.
EngagementAmendment.proposedByAccountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical actor who is the listing creator, not an engagement member, and host-authorized for this engagement's Guild, rechecked after the engagement lock. Root not enabled.
EngagementAmendment.proposedByAccountId.fold: Restrict preserves amendment history and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
EngagementAmendment.proposedByAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration/capacity review pending.

EngagementAmendment.decidedByAccountId.effects: Immutable decider attribution only; acceptance versions the effective terms through the amendment row, never the Engagement, User, Session or Participant.
EngagementAmendment.decidedByAccountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical HUMAN member of the engagement (accept or decline) or the original proposer (withdraw), rechecked after the engagement lock; the database also requires membership.
EngagementAmendment.decidedByAccountId.fold: Restrict preserves the decision and consent record and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
EngagementAmendment.decidedByAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration/capacity review pending.

RaidReplacement.createdByAccountId.effects: Immutable replacement attribution only; the closed engagement, closure, claim and reservation are untouched and no identity ownership moves.
RaidReplacement.createdByAccountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical actor who created the original listing and is host-authorized for its Guild, rechecked after the engagement lock; the database requires the same creator and Guild. Root not enabled.
RaidReplacement.createdByAccountId.fold: Restrict preserves replacement history and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
RaidReplacement.createdByAccountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration/capacity review pending.

Notification.accountId.effects: Append-only recipient attribution of an identifier-only in-app notification; no User/Session/Participant mutation or identity transfer. Text is generated from the kind at read time.
Notification.accountId.authority: System job, not an actor: the recipient is derived from current engagement members, the terms' reviewer or the listing creator; reads and the first-read mark require the recipient's own current Session. Root not enabled.
Notification.accountId.fold: Restrict preserves notification history and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
Notification.accountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration review pending.

NotificationPreference.accountId.effects: One opt-in promotional preference per account; no User/Session/Participant mutation or identity transfer.
NotificationPreference.accountId.authority: Current actual Session/canonical actor for their own account only, rechecked in the transaction. Root not enabled.
NotificationPreference.accountId.fold: Restrict preserves the preference and fails closed on account deletion; no rehome/fold enablement.
NotificationPreference.accountId.review: SELF-EVALUATED; independent task-end authority/migration review pending.
